raw_translation: Yana sanya hannu a kan sashe na farko da aka yanka da base64url da kuma nauyin ZXQPH0000QXZ tare da HMAC-SHA-ZXQPH0001QXZ (HS256), ko kuma yana tabbatar da wannan saka hannun jari a cikin gida. Za ka iya canza canzawa a cikin sakan. An goyi bayan HS256 kawai.
source: It signs the base64url-encoded header and JSON payload with HMAC-SHA-256 (HS256), or verifies that signature locally. You can optionally add an expiration claim in seconds. Only HS256 is supported.
translation: Yana sanya hannu a kan sashe na farko da aka yanka da base64url da kuma nauyin JSON tare da HMAC-SHA-256 (HS256), ko kuma yana tabbatar da wannan saka hannun jari a cikin gida. Za ka iya canza canzawa a cikin sakan. An goyi bayan HS256 kawai.

raw_translation: Mai amfani ga kwatanta ra'ayoyi, alamun shafi, fayilolin daidaitawa da takardun da aka kwafe ba tare da shigar da ɗayan sigar ba.
source: Useful for comparing drafts, code, configuration files and copied documents without uploading either version.
translation: Mai amfani ga kwatanta ra'ayoyi, alamun shafi, fayilolin daidaitawa da takardun da aka kwafe ba tare da shigar da ɗayan sigar ba.
